name: live-band-rock-dnb
style: instrumental, three-piece punk band playing drum and bass by hand at 175 BPM, everyone crashing in together on the first beat, no intro. Session drummer on a battered acoustic kit, sticks flat out, snare like a gunshot, double-time kick-snare shuffle, cymbals smashed open. Bassist digging into a fuzz-blown bass guitar, one ugly looping riff. Guitarist hitting a single power chord on each downbeat, amps howling with feedback between hits. Tracked live in a cramped concrete room, ambient mics, bleed, clipping, sweat, no overdubs
exclude: vocals, singing, shouting, crowd chants, MC, rap, vocal chops, spoken word, synth, drum machine, programmed drums, riser, build-up, fade in, quiet intro, breakdown
lyrics:
[Instrumental]
[Band crashes in on beat one, full volume]
[Riff repeats, drummer flat out, power chord on every downbeat]
[Drum fill, cymbal smash, riff again]
[Dead stop, feedback ringing]
